supporting_observations.claim: The domain controller recorded creation of v.rwong at 13:47 UTC by lena.ward, about five minutes later than the alert's approximate time.
A domain logon by lena.ward from WS-LWARD-01 occurred shortly before the account was created, and the account-creation event uses that same logon ID.

lena.ward added v.rwong to the Vendors group using the same logon ID as the account-creation event. The v.<name> format and Vendors membership match the documented help-desk temporary-account practice.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied records show the creation event and a Vendors group addition, but do not provide a complete view of the account's group memberships or permissions.
The supplied records do not show the request or business approval for this temporary account, or whether the account was subsequently used.
claims_not_established: Whether v.rwong was requested and approved for a legitimate vendor engagement.
Whether v.rwong had other memberships or permissions beyond the observed Vendors group addition.
Whether lena.ward's credentials or workstation were compromised.
unrelated_findings: Separate ticket: WS-LWARD-01 launched OpenSSH to PROXY-SUN-01 on port 22; the supplied inventory says remote administration is only done from WS-IDOYLE-01. The records also show a quiet dotnet SDK installer launched from the user's Temp directory by PowerShell, but do not establish how it was obtained or whether it was related to the SSH connection. (T228-00007, T228-00009, T228-00012)

Separate ticket: lena.ward launched Remote Desktop to FILE-SUN-01 and established a remote-interactive logon there; this is inconsistent with the inventory's stated remote-administration practice. (T228-00015, T228-00019, T228-00020)
Separate ticket: Dropbox.exe was running on WS-LWARD-01; Dropbox is not among the organization's approved file-sharing or cloud-storage services. (T228-00084, T228-00085, T228-00086)
